scope: existing data, artifacts and code audit; no model training or test-based selection

exact_raw_file_duplicates.limitations: Exact digital file equality only; does not exclude near duplicates or unrecorded patient identity errors.

limitations: Repeated inspection of fold10 can inform later experiment design even when code trains on folds1-8 only; fold10 is not a new blind test.
Repeated model and threshold searches on fold9 can overfit validation selection.
Exact raw-file hashes do not establish absence of near duplicates.
Audit checks present artifacts and code, not every historical execution or undocumented manual action.
